scope: Bounded repair of known generic food identity admission within existing workstream 4. No new recognition model, prompt forcing, production admission or identity correction UI.

guard.method: Known whole-label categories, controlled preparation wrappers, comparison-only Unicode normalization, and explicit uncertainty markers.
integration_points: FDC candidate Search eligibility before local/provider lookup
Enrichment eligibility before web-derived positive cache and provider construction
User candidate confirm validation; defer/reject retained
Issued confirmation read before Detail authority
Direct-SQL preview acceptance before profile write
guard.local_hit_scope: Existing official/custom local-hit priority is unchanged. This batch does not ban every generic curated local match.
guard.legacy_scope: Immutable snapshots remain readable. Old generic confirmations and active previews cannot grant new Detail/acceptance authority. Already-accepted results retain same-key evidence replay without new profile writes.

inputs.data_type: Synthetic helper inputs; not recovered phone response or measured food weight

direct_offline_probe.interpretation: Specific-name eligibility does not establish database coverage, compatible prepared-food nutrition, provider success or correct photo identity.

regressions: High and low confidence known generic names, cooking wrappers, quotations and uncertainty markers
Specific Chinese names, legitimate English aliases, and 生菜 not blocked by substring
Duplicate 炒菜葉 IDs with synthetic 40g/70g weights stay separate and unchanged
Mixed generic/specific batches do not attach another item's candidates or weight
Generic HTTP candidate POST returns an empty immutable snapshot and exact replay, with no client factory
Generic HTTP enrichment returns 409 confirmation_required with no cache/provider/quota/request/JTI consumption
Old generic snapshot cannot issue a confirmation revision or confirmation row
Already-issued generic confirmation cannot authorize Detail; evidence replay stays intact
Already-saved generic active preview cannot write profile or change its evidence row
Previously accepted generic same-key replay adds no profile; changed key conflicts

focused_subsets_not_additive_to_full_tot.suite: FDC candidate and enrichment Flask HTTP integration

verification.independent_review: Two read-only review passes found and repaired uncertainty/cooked-label parsing and legacy direct-SQL preview bypasses. Final cross-review found no material new-authority bypass within this bounded scope; not a zero-defect claim.

remaining_boundaries: No controlled current-model photo replay or recognition accuracy comparison in this batch
Actual phone response, scores, rejection reasons, item IDs, save behavior and nutrition truth remain unavailable
Finite lexical guard cannot certify arbitrary names or infer species from searched nutrition
Candidate confirmation copies scan identity; selecting a candidate does not correct a generic name
A genuine identity correction must use a new server-owned revision; no correction UI/route was added here
Runtime flags were not re-inspected; batch 60 health observed only automatic_web_fallback_enabled=false
Production source rights/registry admission and full phone nutrition acceptance remain separate gates
next_bounded_step: Use the supplied photo as a controlled recognition comparison, retaining raw model output and per-item rejection diagnostics to distinguish recognition uncertainty from nutrition mapping. No real provider replay was performed in this batch.
